rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via full name and zip, accessed only the authenticated user’s orders, and provided accurate order details (tracking number 840887978435, tablet storage 64GB, Chicago address for the relevant order). However, the agent updated the user’s default shipping address without first obtaining explicit confirmation after stating the exact change, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any record-changing action. Additionally, when asked to check whether the order was still in transit, the agent deferred to the carrier website instead of clearly restating the internal status (delivered) from the tool results. The main failure is the unconfirmed write to the user profile, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
